designated_partner_applied.actual_use: On the live two-sided D' / cross-disjoint failure branch, use J3>Z3/3 and H2^(i,j)(N)>7E2/32 at eta=1/16 as the input inequalities to the new anchored-star L1 compilers.

new_results.statement: For incident third-volume J3 and any positive anchored residual second-minor family H, weighted determinant interpolation gives the same sharp-HY L1 theorem as the full mixed-(3+2) compiler whenever the mixed row or column marginals satisfy the retained q/2 gate.

If all non-outer incident third-volume marginals on one physical side are <=1/2-gamma, then integral|phi_Q| <=(32 pi e/(3 gamma)) J3^{-a}H^{-b}, with a=(2-gamma)/(2(8-gamma)), b=(1+gamma)/(2(8-gamma)); density continuous C0.

Restrict incident triples to avoid the inner H-row anchor. If their determinant law is row-disjoint from the H-star law with probability delta*>0, then integral|phi_Q| <=10 pi e 2^{-1/5}(delta* Jbar H)^{-1/10}; same by columns.

If star-disjointness delta*<1/16, >3/4 of H companion mass is supported on at most two physical companions, each >3/4 incident under the restricted law. If both row and column star collisions fail, one literal anchored residual 2x2 minor has squared determinant >H/8.

live_application.half_marginal: For any gamma gap below one half, ||p_Q||inf <[16e/(3gamma)](Z3/3)^(-a_gamma)(7E2/32)^(-b_gamma), with phi_Q in L1.
live_application.star_disjoint_canonical: If a_i<=15/16 and delta_i^star>=1/16 on either orientation, ||p_Q||inf<26.768(Z3E2)^(-1/10) and integral|phi_Q|<168.183(Z3E2)^(-1/10).
live_application.collision_survivor: If both canonical star compilers fail without near-coloop anchors, some physical residual 2x2 minor has determinant^2>7E2/256; this is scale currency only, not a reciprocal-minor proof.

corrections_preserved: no reciprocal selected local minor is promoted to a universal result
next_step: In the live two-sided D'/weak-D5 collar, combine the surviving >15/16 incident coloop or the scale-certified physical pair det^2>7E2/256 with J3>Z3/3 and global spectral currency through a product-preserving pair/ridge/grouped-star/scalar-Schur receiver; separately close the exact row/column half-marginal endpoint without an uncontrolled reciprocal minor.
